meta.title: es-canvas — ES editing tool
meta.description: AI presents options. The human makes the final call. An ES (Entry Sheet) editing tool based on the Human-in-the-Loop philosophy.

header.tagline: AI presents options. The human makes the final call.

hero.tagline: AI offers the options. You make the final call.
hero.headline: Polish your essay — in your own voice.
hero.sub: The AI offers the options; you choose. So your essay stays yours, in your own words, to the end.

problem.title: Hand it to AI, and your voice disappears.
problem.body: Hand your essay to AI and it gets rewritten end to end — your individuality gone. es‑canvas does the opposite.
problem.before_2: No idea what changed, or why
problem.after_2: See what changes and why, with reasons
problem.after_3: You decide what to accept or reject
problem.mini_es: In an environmental NPO, I designed a survey of 100 young people and turned the results into a real campaign.

how.title: Three steps
how.step1_body: Your essay, the prompt, and the company you're applying to.
how.step2_body: Sentence-level suggestions — and when something's missing, the AI asks you for it.
how.step3_body: Accept, edit-and-accept, or reject — one at a time. Every action is undoable.

features.title: What makes es‑canvas different
features.f1_body: The AI never rewrites your essay. It only offers options — "here's how you could fix this" — and you choose. Your voice, and every change, stay visible and yours.
features.f2_title: It draws out strengths you didn't write
features.f2_body: The AI asks you back — "what did you do differently here?" — and pulls out material from your experience that wasn't on the page.
features.f3_title: The feedback evolves as you go
features.f3_body: Each time you decide, the rest of the suggestions are rebuilt to match your essay as it stands now. Not a one-shot edit — a living one.
features.f4_body: It researches your target company for real and advises for the kind of person they want — with no fabrication.

philosophy.title: Why you make the final call
philosophy.body: AI isn't a tool for thinking in your place. It's a tool for thinking better yourself. Keep accepting suggestions just because they're convenient, and the sense that you chose this slips away little by little. So es‑canvas never rewrites your essay — it only shows you the options and the reasons behind them. What to accept, what to turn down: each one is yours. This essay stays yours to the end — written in your words, finished by you.
